snippet.title: Hasami: Moonlight Trim - Trailer
snippet.description:
Hasami is a tree pruning game where every cut cleaves through everything it crosses. Find the right angle, pull branches aside with ropes, nurture new growth, and clean endless procedural trees down to their blossom.

Wishlist and try the Free Demo on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5315910/Hasami_Moonlight_Trim/
